mode: Retrospective semantic reconstruction of previously inspected dates; not independent blind validation.
scope: Four P-day KPL primary-label pools: 20260514 semiconductor, 20260520 semiconductor, 20260616 robot, 20260623 robot. Exactly 52 stock-date observations. No hindsight winners added or weak stocks removed.
decision_clock: P final KPL assumed available next trading day 06:00. News evidence must have source datetime no later than this cutoff. Historical first-publication availability is unverified.
axes: Market attention: what narrative and price role was visible? Price commentary describes attention, not business facts or causes.
Economic exposure: issuer versus subsidiary, direct business versus equity association, realized revenue versus development/intentions; preserve the exact subject of a denial.
Leadership role: height, early seal, traded capacity, and thematic representation are separate. High factual purity is not automatically a short-term leader.
branch_rules: Branches are reviewed hypotheses, not an automatic industry truth. Distinguish evidence-backed news interpretation, label-only hypotheses, competing narratives, and unresolved attribution. Preserve raw source labels and unknown members in counts. If using a primary branch for tabulation, do not sum multi-label counts as unique market width.
evidence_rules: News IDs and source datetime required for reviewed claims. KPL list, KPL limit-performance and KPL concept rows share source lineage and do not count as three independent confirmations. Concept descriptions lacking historical first-publication proof are auxiliary and may be stale. No news in a bounded exact-name query means retrieval gap, not absence of a business.
reporting: Report all 52 rows, branch counts by evidence tier, five original height-candidate roles and explicit abstentions. Compare resulting interpretation and candidate roles, not achieved accuracy. Do not modify v1 forecasts or source records.
